name: Halda Barrowe
role: Watch-Captain of Kharun; a Watch lamp on the regency
appearance: Iron-grey braid, broken nose, blackened half-plate with a red-brass gorget.
voice: Gravel; points with a clove-stick; calls everyone lad or lass whatever their size, species or rank.
backstory: A Redcollar all her life, Halda commanded the Sky Gallows details for fifteen years before rising to Watch-Captain. The night the king died she sealed Kharun's gates until the Coal chose; when it didn't, she opened them on her own terms on day 9. She chaired the noon council that made the Lamplit Council regent, refused to hand Isine to the Pyrehouse, and put the forge ward under Watch protection.
wants: Kharun not to burn, her watchmen paid, and a pension somewhere far away.
fears: Soldiers loose inside the walls; a priest or a mob deciding who rules.
secrets: She has seen the real Heartcoal and knows it left Kharun by the Saltgate postern.
She still dreams of the anointings at the Spire.
dm_only: She does not know Lorard is Pellot Rook's son until Marda gives her the record (day 14).
The old v1 secret that she was selling the Watch is unproven in play.

relationships.name: Chadickith
relationships.how: has hired him for years on Okton's word; still talks to him like a promising recruit

relationships.name: Okton
relationships.how: has armoured her Watch for decades; she trusts him

relationships.name: Hesard Rook
relationships.how: the captain who sold her command's secrets; relieved and confined

relationships.name: Tamius Coldwell
relationships.how: the High Pyrewarden she refused at noon on day 3

relationships.name: Lorard Hask
relationships.how: let his column in on her terms; watches his men closely

traits.name: Second Wind
traits.text: Once per short rest, as a bonus action, she regains 1d10 + 7 hit points.

traits.name: Action Surge
traits.text: Once per short rest, one additional action on her turn.

traits.name: Battle Master
traits.text: Four superiority dice (d8): Commander's Strike, Disarming Attack, Rally, Riposte. Maneuver DC 14.
